title: Bumblebee
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="34" rx="17" ry="11" fill="#cfe8ff" transform="rotate(-25 36 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="17" ry="11" fill="#cfe8ff" transform="rotate(25 64 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="34" rx="11" ry="6.5" fill="#eaf6ff" transform="rotate(-25 36 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="34" rx="11" ry="6.5" fill="#eaf6ff" transform="rotate(25 64 34)"/>
  <!-- body base (yellow) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="27" ry="21" fill="#ffd21f"/>
  <!-- darker yellow shading at bottom -->
  <path d="M23 60 a27 21 0 0 0 54 0 a27 24 0 0 1 -54 0 z" fill="#f0b400"/>
  <!-- black stripes as deep blue-purple, curved to wrap body -->
  <path d="M31 45 q19 -7 38 0 q4 4 5 8 q-24 -9 -48 0 q1 -4 5 -8 z" fill="#3d2a6b"/>
  <path d="M26 62 q24 -9 48 0 q-2 8 -7 12 q-17 -7 -34 0 q-5 -4 -7 -12 z" fill="#3d2a6b"/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <polygon points="50,80 46,88 54,88" fill="#3d2a6b"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="15" fill="#ffd21f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#f0b400" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="4.5" fill="#241a45"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="38" r="4.5" fill="#241a45"/>
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="36.5" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="36.5" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 45 q6 5 12 0" fill="none" stroke="#241a45" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="44" r="2.4" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="44" r="2.4" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M45 26 q-5 -9 -12 -11" fill="none" stroke="#3d2a6b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M55 26 q5 -9 12 -11" fill="none" stroke="#3d2a6b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="14" r="3" fill="#3d2a6b"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="14" r="3" fill="#3d2a6b"/>
</svg>
